story: Lady Elara once lived peacefully as a farmer after her days as a knight. One day, she learns that a dark sorceress threatens the kingdom. Determined to protect her people, she gathers brave companions and journeys through dangerous forests. Along the way, they face magical creatures and solve difficult challenges. In the end, through teamwork and courage, Elara defeats the sorceress and restores peace to the kingdom.
